2. Before you go. Open your itinerary and check your flights, hotel and documents. On a phone, add it to your home screen and it works offline.
3. On the road. Your itinerary has your confirmation numbers, your documents and who to call.
4. When you're back. Attach each receipt to its cost on the trip within a week, and accounting reimburses you from there.
